description: This file contains the implementation of ShardRegionExtractor, a class that implements Akka's ShardRegion.MessageExtractor interface for hashCode-based sharding in a cluster. It manages message entity IDs, shard IDs, and message mapping strategies, enabling efficient distributed message routing and processing in the cluster.

classes.name: ShardRegionExtractor
classes.description: A final class implementing Akka's ShardRegion.MessageExtractor to distribute messages across cluster shards using hashCode of entity IDs, with support for custom mapping strategies and message handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create ShardRegionExtractor with specified number of shards and ActorSystem, loading mapping strategies.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create ShardRegionExtractor with specified number of shards and explicit mapping strategies.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Extracts the entity ID from various message types like ShardedMessageEnvelope, WithId, or ShardRegion.StartEntity.

methods.name: entityMessage
methods.description: Converts incoming messages to a Jsonifiable object if necessary, handling JSON deserialization for cross-node messages.

methods.name: shardId
methods.description: Generates a shard ID based on the hash code of the entity ID, ensuring non-negative values and modulo with total number of shards.

methods.name: getInactiveShardIds
methods.description: Returns a set of shard IDs that are not currently active, given a collection of active shard IDs.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Creates a Jsonifiable object from a ShardedMessageEnvelope using the appropriate mapping strategy based on message type.
